title: Defense in depth
content: Defense in depth is an information-security strategy that integrates people, technology, and operations capabilities to establish layered protections across multiple organizational levels.

title: Principle of least privilege
content: Least privilege restricts each entity to the minimum authorizations and resources required to perform its assigned function.

title: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures
content: A CVE identifier is a stable identifier for one publicly disclosed cybersecurity vulnerability. A CVE record does not by itself express current exploitation probability or asset-specific risk.

title: Common Vulnerability Scoring System
content: CVSS communicates the intrinsic severity characteristics of a vulnerability. Severity should be combined with threat intelligence, exposure, asset criticality, and compensating controls when prioritizing remediation.

title: Incident response lifecycle
content: Incident response integrates preparation with detection, response, and recovery. Evidence preservation, scoping, containment, eradication, recovery, and lessons learned must follow organizational procedures.

title: Evidence and inference policy
content: VERA treats retrieved records and observed events as evidence, while correlations, intent attribution, and impact estimates remain system inferences unless an authoritative source directly supports them.
